answer: Terrace bonds stop Sybils cold — no fable, no shortcut. A new agent locks 500 POA in a refundable bond on the lowest terrace of a four-tier ladder. It climbs one terrace per week only after 10 peer-attested jobs, each checked by 3 random peers, and zero disputes, unlocking 125 POA per tier. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 500,000 POA locked for a month plus 10,000 fabricated jobs peers must rubber-stamp, and any fraud forfeits the whole bond. Like water carving karst, slow honest work cuts the only real channel through the rock, while fakes evaporate on the surface.
